zh.title: 今天很清静,来开一场对话?
zh.body: 如果你现在没有悬着的运行、审批或排程，就直接让 Friday 帮你开一个新的执行线程。

en.title: It's quiet today. Want to start a conversation?
en.body: If there are no runs, approvals, or schedules hanging over you, let Friday open a fresh execution thread.

zh.title: 从一个明确的目标开始
zh.body: 先把目标、边界和你想要的结果说清楚，Friday 才能把对话变成一条可执行的线程。
zh.cta: 复核今天的高风险运行→

en.title: Start with a concrete goal
en.body: State the goal, boundary, and desired outcome clearly so Friday can turn the chat into an executable thread.

zh.title: 连接你的第一个渠道
zh.body: 从 Amazon、Shopify、TikTok 或其他渠道开始，Friday 才能把它们接进收件箱和自动化。

en.title: Connect your first channel
en.body: Start with Amazon, Shopify, TikTok, or another channel so Friday can wire them into inboxes and automations.

zh.title: 还没有用量数据
zh.body: 开始对话后这里会出现详情。

en.title: No usage data yet
en.body: Once you start chatting, the usage detail appears here.

zh.title: Friday 还没有记住任何事
zh.body: 当你确认偏好、规则和长期背景后，它们会按 scope 沉淀在这里。

en.title: Friday has not remembered anything yet
en.body: Once you confirm preferences, rules, and long-term context, they settle here by scope.

zh.title: 还没有连接设备
zh.body: 把受信设备接进 Fleet 后，Friday 才能把远程执行和健康心跳接进控制台。

en.title: No devices connected yet
en.body: Once trusted devices join Fleet, Friday can bring remote execution and health heartbeats into the console.
